g.text: Injection occurs after every decode emits >=8 tokens. Scheduler evidence verifies actual batch size and mixed execution; no KV network transfer is involved.

g.text: Full: 0 cached + 1024 new tokens. Append: 2048 cached + 1024 new tokens. Decode: 2048 cached + 4 new, then 128 output tokens.
